title: Regenerate Genz App logo asset for crisp header rendering

requirements.summary: Regenerate the Genz App logo PNG asset as a crisp 512×512 image while keeping the existing public path used by the header icon.
acceptanceCriteria: The file `frontend/public/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` exists and is a valid 512×512 PNG.
The logo appears sharp (not blurry/pixelated) when displayed in the header at the current responsive sizes (see `frontend/src/components/Header.tsx` where it is shown with rounded corners).
The public asset path remains exactly `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png` (no filename/path changes required elsewhere).

file_operations.description: Regenerate/replace the logo image as a sharp, clean, transparency-preserving 512×512 PNG optimized to render crisply when downscaled to ~40–80 CSS pixels with rounded corners in the header. Keep the public asset path exactly `/assets/generated/genz-app-logo.dim_512x512.png`.
